notes.title: Patch Notes (v0.24)
notes.notes:
Check out the changes below:

- Mussa's visuals have been updated
- Added difficulty modes (easy, normal and hard)
- Minor improvements, general adjustments and corrections

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.23 (achievements)
notes.notes:
We have just released version 0.23 bringing stats and achievements to the game! There are up to 53 achievements planed to the full game while in the current version 51 are already available!

We hope you have fun unlocking all the available achievements, and please, share your feedback on how is the difficulty to get them.

Soon we are going to uploading final arts for all the achievements.

notes.title: Version 0.22 released! Level 5 of the cave is now available!
notes.notes:
We have released a new level based on the cave theme. It is the boss battle of the cave!

The challenge here is to beat the giant marmot controlled by the haters. Inspired on the classic boss battles of the 90s games, you are going to face changes on the behavior of the boss while beating him.

Please, share with us your feedback. Your support will help us make a great game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32518405/d2b4f576cae804c2f68c0b8f647b3254889a6d4b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32518405/d1c0787247c249ed92e4ba928b03f9af792ff49d.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.21 released! Level 4 of the cave world is now available.
notes.notes:
We have just released a new cave level. The new level is an underwater maze where the character swiming through many challenges. You need to find the exit while avoiding enemies like the piranhas and the Hater Divers, all of that while breathing under water with the help of air bubbles that you will find. Take carefull with the water current, it can take you back to the start of the level.

Enjoy the new game level and please, share with us your valuable feedback.

notes.title: Version 0.20 released! Level 3 of the cave now available.
notes.notes:
We have released a new level of the cave theme. The new level brings a new gameplay mechanics where you have Mussa on a mine cart running fast on trails of an old mine.

Enjoy the new game level. Please, share your feedback.

notes.title: Version 0.19 released - New cave level available to play!
notes.notes:
We have release a new game level from the cave theme. This new game level brings the game experience into the darkness. With a limited field of view you have to pay better attention to details and proceed with caution while trying to get to the finish line.

Enjoy the new level and please, share with us your valuable feedback. We are counting on you to help us make an awesome game!

notes.title: Version 0.18 released - New game level available to play!
notes.notes:
We have release a new game level from the third game world, the cave. This new game world brings a lot of new mechanics and challenges into the game. The first level of the cave world has new enemies, secret paths, different challenges like an earthquake and more.

Enjoy the new level and please, share with us your valuable feedback. We are counting on you to help us make an awesome game!

notes.title: Patch Note - 0.17.2
notes.notes:
We have just released another minor game update concerning gameplay adjustments and minor bug fixes. 

More details:
- Game difficulty adjustments on the levels: 4, 7 and 8.
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.17
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32518405/01e21c6fe983bbdd62f6322fb7a0252998621a30.png[/img]

The update is focused in reducing game difficulty. A checkpoint is now added to each game level and areas of tension were adjusted to become easier to pass.

Patch Notes
- Checkpoints added to the game levels
- Adjustment to character movement and jumping
- Game levels adjustments
- Some enemies were removed from a variety of levels

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.16.1
notes.notes:
- The player now earns extra lives collecting hearts when already having 5 hearts
- Removed character movement deceleration when no movement input is present
